title: Statement envelope
description: What every party statement carries: the deployment and protocol version it belongs to, void at any other (REQ-PRT-1); the shape of the statement inside it; its maker and time; and the maker's signature, so it stays attributed to its maker and a restatement by anyone else is detectable (REQ-AUD-2, REQ-QTE-1). A schema for a particular statement refers to this one by $id, fixes shape to its own $id, and narrows statement. Signing rule (ruled by the orchestrator, 2026-11-06): the signed bytes are the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of the whole envelope with only the top-level signature.value removed, canonicalised from the JSON as received, never from a re-serialisation of parsed types; duplicate member names are rejected; the scheme is Ed25519 (RFC 8032), verified strictly; every integer that can be signed is at most 2^53 - 1, or is carried as a string.

deployment.description: The deployment the statement belongs to, globally unique and bound to its operator. Elsewhere the statement is void (REQ-PRT-1, THR-8).

operator_key.description: The operator's public key, which binds the deployment to its operator.

protocol_version.description: The protocol version the statement belongs to (REQ-PRT-1).

shape.description: The $id of the schema the statement follows, such as urn:rutent:provider-role:result. Signed with the rest, so a statement can't be presented as another kind.

maker.description: The party that made the statement.

signature.description: The maker's signature over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the whole envelope with only the top-level signature.value removed.

scheme.description: The signature scheme: Ed25519 (RFC 8032), verified strictly.

key.description: The public key that signed: one of the maker's published keys, or the deployment's operator_key for the operator.

value.description: The 64-byte signature, base64url without padding, in its one canonical encoding: the last character carries no unused bits.

statement.description: The statement itself, in the shape named by shape.
